punchline: A hard task you put off doesn't get lighter. You just carry it longer.
thirty_sec: There's one thing on your list you really don't want to do. If you start with email and easy wins, that task runs in the back of your mind all day, pulling at your focus. Then it gets your most tired hour at the end. If you do it first, while your energy is highest, you have one uncomfortable hour. After that the rest of the day moves faster, because nothing is weighing on you.
question: What was the first thing you worked on today, and was it the thing you most needed to get done?
